info.title: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
info.synopsis: Konoha Sato è una studentessa delle medie che, come molte ragazze della sua età, sogna di vivere un'avventura romantica. Ma lei non si limita all'immaginazione e decide di scrivere Dark History, un romanzo fantasy sentimentale con lei nei panni dell'eroina principale. Anni dopo la madre ritrova questo racconto e nel mentre Konoha finisce coinvolta in un incidente mortale. Quando la ragazza riapre gli occhi si rende conto di ritrovarsi nel mondo da lei stesso creato ma con una "piccola" complicazione... lei è Iana, la sorella minore ed antagonista della storia! Riuscirà Konoha a ricordarsi ogni minimo dettaglio del suo racconto per evitare che si attivi una "death flag" per il suo personaggio?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Office worker Satou Konoha dies in an accident and is reborn as a character from a story she wrote as a student—The Dark History. Instead of reincarnating as the heroine as she'd hoped, she's the hated little sister, Iana. And, according to the story, she's destined to perish early on at the hands of her butler! There's only one way to survive—remember the plot of the story and avoid her fate!

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: To save Konoha from the monster that kidnaps her, Iana triggers her own death flag. With help from Sol, Ginoford, and the others, Konoha's rescue succeeds. Iana barely has time to relax before an invitation to a ball arrives from the capital—the very ball that's the setting for chapter 3 of The Dark History. If Konoha dances with the prince at the ball, it will lead to a death flag for Iana!

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: As Iana grows used to life in the world she's been reincarnated into, a young man comes to visit—her childhood friend Yomi, back from studying abroad. When Iana remembers Yomi, a character she created, she is left aghast.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Yomi mistakenly believes that Sol is oppressing Iana. Out of pure feelings and loyalty for Iana, he tries to kill Sol. Konoha is attacked by a man-eating flower created by Yomi's magic. After defeating it with Ginoford, Sol begins to suspect that suspicious events happening around him are also targeting him, and turns his eyes to Iana. Yomi declares, "I did it," and challenges Sol to a duel!

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Iana confronts Yomi, taking up Sol's sword in his place, but it's so heavy that Iana can't even swing it. Yomi, who loves Iana, concedes the duel, casting his own sword aside. The matter is settled for the moment, but if nothing changes Yomi will keep trying to kill Konoha. No amount of persuasion from Iana seems likely to make Yomi give up. What desperate measures has Iana come up with instead?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Iana sneaks into town with Konoha where she sees just how popular Konoha is, and how despised she is herself. Back at home, a man named Cheneau drops by. He's vice captain of the Police Security Force's Hydrangea Unit, and he once arrested Iana on suspicion of Konoha's attempted murder. He's been investigating the disappearances of beautiful young ladies, and he has his eye on Iana as a suspect.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Iana heatedly declares to her new friend Menoa's older half-sister, "This girl is no slave!" By causing an uproar at Duchess Amaryllis' party, Iana attracts even more suspicion from Cheneau. And right at that moment, Menoa disappears. Iana, who found and picked up the earring that Menoa was wearing, is suspected to be the culprit behind the disappearing beauties incidents.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Duchess Amaryllis is Bloody Rosa, the person who has been kidnapping beautiful girls. In order to save Menoa, Iana convinces Cheneau to help her, and they commence working together. But a trap sends Iana and Cheneau tumbling into Duchess Amaryllis' hands. The two are held captive in the basement—an insane "paradise" where the kidnapped Menoa and Cheneau's younger sister are also being held.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: To save Cheneau, Menoa, and the abducted beauties, Iana confronts Duchess Amaryllis as the brilliant villainess, Iana Magnolia! The Hydrangea unit arrives just in time, but Iana realizes that the captured duchess is resolved to die and acts to save her. The case is closed. Or, it should have been, but for some reason, Sol is enraged. Has this incident flipped his murderous motivation switch?

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Iana has fought hard to change the Dark History, but she realizes that the story is being altered in ways that she can't control. While visiting a country villa, Iana and the others meet a boy accompanying a wounded elf and decide to look after them—an event that signals that the vampire incident is about to occur. As Iana prepares to check the vampire's tomb, Sol asks her to take him along.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The seal on the stone tomb is broken. As Iana races to look for the one who is missing from the coffin, she is attacked by elves who have turned into vampires. Sol and Yomi come running and save her, and after realizing that she isn't alone, Iana continues onward. But when Shukuna appears to help them, he guides them to a place where an unexpected twist awaits.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Iana attends upon the Vampire King, but it's all an act. Traces of Konoha's saintess blood on her handkerchief allow Iana to escape being turned into a vampire, and she challenges the Vampire King to battle, alone. Then, when she goes back to find Yomi, she discovers that there has been an unexpected turn of events. What is happening in the pages of the Dark History?

info.title: One Piece: Le avventure del detective Cappello di Paglia (ITA)
info.synopsis: In una terra lontana chiamata Grande Zipangu è primavera. La banda di malviventi capitanati da Bagy attacca l'agenzia di cambio gestita da Ipponmatsu. In quello stesso momento Rufy sta mangiando al ristorante gestito da Nami e paga con dei soldi requisiti a dei falsari, ignaro che si tratta appunto di denaro contraffatto. Usop lo raggiunge e lo informa che il gruppo di Bagy è arrivato in città e sta seminando il caos. Rufy allora decide di andare ad arrestarli...

info.title: The Strongest Job is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!
info.synopsis: Hibiki, uno studente delle superiori, viene improvvisamente trasportato in un altro mondo e si ritrova a vagare da solo in una vasta prateria popolata da mostri. Tutto ciò che possiede sono abilità non combattive, come ad esempio la “valutazione”! In una situazione apparentemente senza speranza, Hibiki trova salvezza grazie a incontri inaspettati, e presto le sue abilità straordinarie iniziano a fiorire! Ha così inizio un’avventura dove miracolosi poteri da "cheater" ribaltano ogni previsione!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Manabe Hibiki suddenly finds himself in an isekai. After finally getting out of a maze, he meets Emalia.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: When the Tutorial skill levels up, Hibiki loses his "Guide." But he slowly learns how to do things on his own.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Hibiki gains two companions, Claude and Lillian. And apparently the Tutorial skill is incredibly good.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Vene teaches Hibiki and Lillian the basics of magic. After ages, Hibiki manages to learn... a cleaning spell.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Hibiki puts on girls clothes and looks really good in them. But he is doing that just to catch a thief!

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Ivell sends Hibiki's party deeper into the woods, and Hibiki gets mortally wounded. Can't anyone help?!

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Sapo-chan announces that Enlightened Mode of the Expert Eye is activated, but how can it help Claude?

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: It's so hot that everyone is suffering, especially Claude. Hibiki sets out to find a way to cool them down.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Hibiki and party join Fauna in trying to vanquish an endless undead horde to save a village.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The party made it to the northern dungeon. But right before they enter they're talking about... underpants?

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Hibiki finds out that he can actually copy/paste rented skills and questions if that's not cheating.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Hibiki is all alone and has to face Ivell who is out for blood. She even reduces all his levels down to 1...

info.title: Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table: 44 - Cloudy Beach
info.synopsis: La storia del film prosegue dalla serie, dopo che Yūki ha superato la maledizione del "muro dei trent'anni", che riduce drasticamente il tasso di sopravvivenza dei giocatori. Yūki questa volta si trova su un'isola remota in mezzo all'oceano con altri sette giocatori, tra cui un suo conoscente. Il nuovo gioco è il cosiddetto "Cloudy Beach"...

info.title: The World's Strongest Witch
info.synopsis: Rona è stata cacciata di casa. Sola e disperata scopre di possedere in realtà una skill unica di classe SSS: “Internet”. Questa skill le permette di accedere ai “siti guida” di questo mondo. Grazie alla sua abilità può produrre oggetti di valore in maniera illimitata, guadagnare materiali rarissimi e fare tante altre cose.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Lorna goes on an adventure with her skill, the Internet, which grants her access to near infinite knowledge.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Lorna arrives in Aiphoné and goes to register with the adventurer's guild.

episodes.title: I Tried Looking at Message Boards!
episodes.synopsis: Lorna must overcome a dungeon considered impossible to complete if she wants to pass the exam.
